const arr=[];for(const i of set){const [r,c]=rc(i);for(const [dr,dc] of [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]){const nr=r+dr,nc=c+dc;if(nr<0||nr>7||nc<0||nc>7)continue;const j=idx(nr,nc);if(!cells[j].revealed&&!arr.includes(j))arr.push(j);}}return arr;

const m=new Map();for(const g of groups){if(g.cells.length<4)continue;const pos=g.cells.includes(preferred)?preferred:g.cells[Math.floor(g.cells.length/2)];m.set(pos,g.cells.length>=5?{special:"prism",gem:null}:{special:g.dir==="h"?"rocketH":"rocketV",gem:g.color});}return m;

for(let c=0;c<8;c++){let r=7;while(r>=0){if(!(cells[idx(r,c)].revealed&&cells[idx(r,c)].type==="gem")){r--;continue;}let end=r,start=r;while(start-1>=0&&cells[idx(start-1,c)].revealed&&cells[idx(start-1,c)].type==="gem")start--;const stack=[];for(let rr=end;rr>=start;rr--){const x=cells[idx(rr,c)];if(x.gem||x.special)stack.push({gem:x.gem,special:x.special});}let w=end;for(const item of stack){const d=cells[idx(w,c)];if(d.gem!==item.gem||d.special!==item.special)drop.add(idx(w,c));d.gem=item.gem;d.special=item.special;w--;}while(w>=start){const d=cells[idx(w,c)];d.gem=rand(COLORS);d.special=null;drop.add(idx(w,c));w--;}r=start-1;}}

const create=specialCreates(groups,preferred),clear=new Set(matched);for(const i of matched)if(cells[i].special&&cells[i].special!=="prism")activateRocket(i,clear);for(const p of create.keys())clear.delete(p);

if(!findGroups().length){cells[a].gem=A.gem;cells[a].special=A.special;cells[b].gem=B.gem;cells[b].special=B.special;stats.invalid++;fx.bad=new Set([a,b]);render();await sleep(300);fx.bad.clear();selected=null;locked=false;sfx.bad();setStatus("This swap does not make a match.");render();return;}

function eliteWeb(){const ids=cells.map((c,i)=>c.type==="gem"&&!elite.webbed.has(i)?i:-1).filter(i=>i>=0);if(ids.length){const i=rand(ids);elite.webbed.add(i);setStatus("Silk Matriarch webbed a tile. Match beside it to break the web.");}}
